title: Standard returns
text: Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. A 15% restocking fee applies to furniture.

title: Transit guarantee
text: A delay of more than 48 hours past the promised delivery window entitles the customer to a free replacement or a full refund, with the return fee waived.

title: Chair warranty
text: Office chairs carry a 5-year warranty on frame and mechanism and 2 years on upholstery and mesh.

title: Inventory hold
text: Business buyers may hold stock for 15 minutes while a purchase order is approved. Unconfirmed holds return to general stock.
